pick.headline: Reagan at the Brandenburg Gate: tear down this wall
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 15, 1987, listed under Poland that PAP 'Attacks Reagan Statements at Berlin Wall', saying they showed 'nerve' and signaled an 'anticommunist crusade', after a long run of papal-visit items.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 114, 15 June 1987
evidence.snippet: …10 Jun] Pope Speaks at 8 June Ecumenical Council Session [SLOWO POWSZECHNE 10 Jun] Pope Addresses Nuns at Warsaw Cathedral 8 June ([SLOWO POWSZECHNE 10 Jun] Official Says Church Government's 'Partner' [DPA] PAP Attacks Reagan Statements at Berlin Wall Shows 'Nerve' With Accusations Signals 'Anticommunist Crusade’
